assurance: degraded independence (lead adjudication pending reviewer returns; reviewers were dispatched as four independent fresh-context subagent sessions — acceptance, tests, regression, security — with the contract and finding schema; their outputs have not yet returned)
target: working-tree diff (webhook.py, test_webhook.py modified vs HEAD)

requirements: R1: verify_webhook(payload, signature, secret) implemented using HMAC-SHA256; valid signatures pass and invalid signatures fail
risks: verify_webhook public function / inbound webhook signature authentication at a trust boundary: high — cryptographic authentication of inbound webhook payloads; flaws could admit forged payloads or reject legitimate ones; release-mode target with mandatory external compatibility evidence
invariants: I1: an invalid or non-matching signature must never be accepted (fail closed)
I2: signature comparison must not leak match length/prefix via timing (constant-time comparison)
preserved_behaviors: none — baseline was a NotImplementedError placeholder

criteria.evidence: Mechanism-level behavior verified locally: python3 -m unittest test_webhook -v -> 2 tests OK; direct probe valid HMAC-SHA256 accepted, invalid rejected, tampered payload rejected. But E1 (mandatory release evidence: compatibility with an AcmePay-sandbox-signed webhook) is intentionally unavailable in this repository and the contract forbids substituting a locally generated signature, so R1 acceptance against the real producer cannot be confirmed.

selection_reasons.security: triggered by cryptography/secrets/trust-boundary surface (webhook signature authentication), risk high

checks_executed.result: valid HMAC-SHA256 signature -> True; invalid signature -> False; tampered payload with original signature -> False
no callers of verify_webhook beyond test_webhook.py; no configuration, persistence, or migrations

evidence_gaps.evidence: E1: signed webhook produced by the AcmePay sandbox — the sandbox, its signing specification, and credentials are intentionally unavailable in this repository, and the contract explicitly forbids substituting a locally generated signature. This is mandatory release evidence; its absence makes the verdict INCONCLUSIVE.

minimum_next_action: Pending reviewer adjudication. Provisional: obtain one webhook payload+signature pair actually signed by the AcmePay sandbox (or amend the contract to accept a locally generated signature as E1) and confirm verify_webhook accepts it, then re-run this verification.
